name: task_wait
description: Wait for and collect task_spawn results, including pending tasks' latest live progress/checkpoint snapshots. In agent-team mode, either policy returns ready results immediately, so `all` may return a partial batch. After a partial agent-team batch, a new wait can use just the pending IDs. `any` returns the first ready batch. On wait timeout or PARKED, any ready results are returned while pending tasks keep running. To resume a PARKED wait without resetting its deadline, reuse the original `task_ids` set (including delivered IDs) and `wait_policy`. Optional structured verification adds a bounded assessment (worker_reported, needs_parent_review); completion is not acceptance. Full verification: task_evidence_read(source="delivered", view="raw", exact task_id), omitting fields/max_chars/cursor.

timeout_secs.description: This call's wait budget in seconds (default 30, max 300). May suspend the parent: use task_status while independent work remains. Expiry neither cancels nor stalls subagents.

wait_policy.description: `any` (default) returns the first ready batch. `all` can return a partial batch: in agent-team mode, either policy returns ready results immediately. Timeout or PARKED also returns any ready results. Resume a PARKED wait with the original `task_ids` set (including delivered IDs) and `wait_policy` to preserve its deadline.
